name: kobe-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Rove, the terminal-native agent multiplexer, plus its branding pipeline.

scripts.daemon: cd packages/kobe && bun run src/cli/rove.ts daemon start
scripts.daemon:stop: cd packages/kobe && bun run src/cli/rove.ts daemon stop
scripts.daemon:restart: cd packages/kobe && bun run src/cli/rove.ts daemon restart
scripts.daemon:status: cd packages/kobe && bun run src/cli/rove.ts daemon status
scripts.daemon:kobe: cd packages/kobe && bun run src/cli/kobe.ts daemon start
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @sma1lboy/rove-plugin-sdk build && bun --filter @sma1lboy/kobe-daemon typecheck && bun --filter @sma1lboy/rove typecheck && bun --filter @sma1lboy/rove-plugin-sdk typecheck
scripts.test: bun --filter @sma1lboy/rove-plugin-sdk build && bun --filter @sma1lboy/rove test && bun --filter @sma1lboy/rove-plugin-sdk test
scripts.lint: biome check biome.json package.json docs packages/kobe packages/kobe-daemon packages/kobe-plugin-sdk --config-path ./biome.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check biome.json package.json docs packages/kobe packages/kobe-daemon packages/kobe-plugin-sdk --config-path ./biome.json --write
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'pre-commit hook enabled (.githooks)'
scripts.ci:version: changeset version && bun install && bun run lint:fix
